messages:
Aisha: @here Rolling out SDK v2.1.0 (Python & JS) now to hosted and dedicated. This includes a docs refresh + one behavioral change that could be breaking for some customers. see below :rocket:
Ben: Which behavioral change? any API surface removal?
Aisha: Not removal, default retry/backoff policy changed to exponential with jitter (was linear). This affects long polling & low-latency loops. We keep the old behavior via client config: retries.strategy='linear' or retries=0
Marta: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Marta: Migration guide added: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/migration-2-1
Marta: Short snippet to opt-out:
```
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=..., retries={'type':'linear','max_attempts':2})
```
Kai: Heads up: sync python v0 will be deprecated 2026-06-30 — announced to customers next week. Please surface any embedded usages in infra.
Ben: Any rollout plan for Dedicated/private? We shouldn't auto-upgrade private control planes.
Aisha: Dedicated & Private will stay on v2.0 unless customers opt-in. We'll mark the hosted default as v2.1. We have a canary rollout to 10% + monitoring for 48h.
CI Bot: Release pipeline: builds succeeded for packages: redwood-python@2.1.0, redwood-js@2.1.0. Changelogs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/releases/tag/v2.1.0
Sam: Docs team will add redirects for deprecated endpoints by EOD Friday. Also updating quickstarts.
Marta: Also added a 'breaking changes' banner at top of SDK pages and a checklist for SEs to run before contacting customers.
Ben: I'll run a quick scan of internal repos for client instantiations and post results here by EOD.
Kai: Also update the customer-facing migration email draft in #marketing before Monday.
Aisha: Thx all — if you see urgent regressions ping @Aisha directly. Postmortem slots reserved if needed. :thumbsup:
